video_title: Post Game Media Availability | Preseason | October 13, 2026 | OKC Thunder

quotes.speaker: Jalen Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Williams on the value of crunch-time experience for young players
quotes.excerpt: Anytime you can get real game experience and especially crunch time in close games, it means a lot.
quotes.quote: Anytime you can get real game experience and especially crunch time in close games, it means a lot. That is a spot that we have not really been in a ton, so it is a great look for us to see if we are ever in that position in a real NBA game that really counts for playoff stuff and win-loss column. It is really good for us to get that experience.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Williams emphasizes the importance of getting crunch time experience during the preseason to prepare for high stakes NBA games

quotes.speaker: Jalen Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Williams on Zaire Williams' veteran influence on the Thunder
quotes.excerpt: He is the ultimate pro. He is super mature, influencing the guys with the blue, even me.
quotes.quote: The funniest thing about Zaire Williams, I think my first couple games with the Blue, we played in Dallas against the Texas Legends and he was on the Legends. Both games went to overtime, we ended up winning both, but it was super fun games. Flash forward a month later, we traded for him in the Blue and he is a guy that is the ultimate pro. He has got a couple kids, he is super mature, influencing the guys with the Blue, even me. He is an amazing dude and it was cool to see him get hot there at the end and really go win us the game.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Williams praises Zaire Williams for his veteran presence and maturity since joining the Thunder organization

quotes.speaker: Jalen Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Williams on supporting teammate Ortega through injury setbacks
quotes.excerpt: Regardless of what it is, he is going to be okay.
quotes.quote: Anytime you see somebody get hurt, whatever it may be, it is never good. But Ortega, the kind of kid he is, regardless of what it is, he is going to be okay. He is such a lively person, whenever he walks into the room he picks up a smile on everybody's face. It has been really cool, me and him have a couple mutual friends we did not even know before he got here, and he got here and we really bonded in the couple months since Summer League. He is an amazing human being.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Williams shares his support for teammate Ortega as he works through injury setbacks

quotes.speaker: Jalen Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Williams on stepping up in clutch moments during his second year
quotes.excerpt: Anytime you are no longer a rookie or first year and you have some experience, you want to do more.
quotes.quote: Anytime you are no longer a rookie or first year and you have some experience, you want to do more. Whatever it may be, being more aggressive or just getting into crunch time games. I just really wanted to be able to hold my own more this year. I got to see a whole year go through it and this is the best program to do that. I just think I get better every day just being around these guys.
quotes.social_post: Entering his second year Jalen Williams says he is focused on being more aggressive and holding his own in clutch moments

quotes.speaker: Jalen Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Williams on his growth and confidence after his rookie season
quotes.excerpt: I am more confident in shooting the ball, defensively, everywhere, because I have had a whole year.
quotes.quote: I just really took this year to assess what I did last year. My Blue season was honestly really good. I definitely did not do as much as I would like to do on the NBA level in the experience that I got, but it is really hard for rookies to do that. The coolest thing about seeing Lou and Wiggs, seeing how they came up from where I started and then them moving on to other teams and going to get even more of an opportunity. It is aspiring for me because those guys helped a lot. I am more confident in shooting the ball, defensively, everywhere, because I have had a whole year to just mature and honestly just get better.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Williams feels more confident in his shooting and defensive game after a year of maturing within the Thunder program

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault praises Zaire Williams for his professional readiness
quotes.excerpt: A great example of somebody being professionally ready to go.
quotes.quote: Give him a lot of credit because he did not play in the second half last night and obviously did not play in the regulation, so he goes in fresh in overtime and was ready to play. So, a great example of somebody being professionally ready to go. He jumped right into the game and obviously gave us a great lift there.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault highlights Zaire Williams for his professional readiness after coming off the bench to provide a lift in overtime

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on managing the pace and variance of Indiana's style
quotes.excerpt: With the way Indiana plays, there is a variance to the game because of the pace.
quotes.quote: With the way Indiana plays, there is a variance to the game because of the pace and it can get frenetic against them. So you kind of have to buckle up and be ready for some swings in both directions. When you are down like that, 20, 17, whatever it is, it just is about trusting your stuff and just trying to win the next possession and trusting the length of the game.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault on managing the frenetic pace against Indiana saying you have to buckle up and trust your stuff when the game swings

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on the fluidity of the team's rotation
quotes.excerpt: The rotation is not like a set in stone thing that you like graduate to.
quotes.quote: The rotation is not like a set in stone thing that you like graduate to. It is obviously fluid based on circumstance and it is for us, it is really fluid. It is fluid night to night, so that is not something that you like lock into or are completely out of. But I trust both of those guys. They have done a nice job in the preseason. They clearly have strengths that they can get into the game that can help the team. We have a lot of guys that can do that. That has been kind of a mark of our team and we think we can continue that with the new guys. Those guys, Josh, Brooks, we think those guys bring good utility to us.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault says the Thunder rotation is fluid night to night and not set in stone as the team evaluates utility players like Josh and Brooks

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on Josh Dix's all-around game and development
quotes.excerpt: He clearly has a pretty rounded game and does not make a lot of mistakes out there.
quotes.quote: We gave him first quarter minutes tonight because we wanted to see him with the returning rotation players and he did a nice job in that stretch. We started him in the second half with Shay, Cason, and Mara, and Dub for the same reason, just to give him a look there because he has got the kind of reliability that tends to translate well to our lineups when we have got those guys out there. He is rock solid on both ends of the floor, he is in the right spots, he is competitive, he plays the right way. He clearly has a pretty rounded game and does not make a lot of mistakes out there.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault praises Josh Dix for his reliability and rounded game after giving him minutes with the primary rotation players

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on the competitive nature of preseason games
quotes.excerpt: I thought that was a competitive game all the way throughout, even into the fourth quarter.
quotes.quote: I thought that was a competitive game all the way throughout, even into the fourth quarter. That can be hit or miss in the preseason, but both teams came to play. Shout out to Halliburton, he looks great. I mentioned that before the game, but obviously that is a long road back for him and there is a history with us because it happened in that series. So it is happy to see him out there number one and in that form number two, he looks tremendous.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault notes it was great to see Tyrese Haliburton back in form and playing well during their preseason matchup

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on Jared's unique live-dribble threat
quotes.excerpt: There is an electricity to him when he has got the ball. He is always a threat.
quotes.quote: There is an electricity to him when he has got the ball. He is always a threat and he is always live, to his credit. People say that, it is like every action is live or every play is live, it is really live with him. And so he kind of gets the defense pretty frenetic and edgy when the ball is in his hands and he can change the tempo of the game almost mid-possession. The possessions kind of dead on one end of the floor and then it gets to his hands and all of a sudden it comes to life pretty quickly and it could get the defense reacting pretty quickly.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault describes the unique threat of Jared saying there is an electricity to him that makes the defense frenetic when the ball is in his hands

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on James Johnson's role as the team's soul
quotes.excerpt: He is like the soul of our team for that reason. He has been for a long time.
quotes.quote: He is like the soul of our team for that reason. He has been for a long time and it is, he is like that in practice. You never have to turn him up. You might have to turn him down a little bit, but you never have to turn him up. He is a competitor, he is a hooper. He has got an unbelievable competitive spirit and it is contagious inside the team. It is a great tone setter and he is 30 something years old, 30, 31, and it is the fourth quarter and everybody else is out of the game and he is competing.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault calls James Johnson the soul of the team citing his unbelievable competitive spirit as a tone setter for the entire roster
